mapper.select:
SELECT structure_id, product_id, security_number, project_structure, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE_VALUE = c.project_structure and s.code = 'ABS.PRORITY_LEVEL') project_structure_n, project_grade, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE_VALUE = c.project_grade and s.code = 'ABS.SUBJECT_RATE') project_grade_n, publish_amount, predict_rate, predict_due_date, description, term_month, structure_precent, ref_structure_id, security_short_name FROM ct_abs_product_structure c
c.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT CAPS.*, (CAPS.PREDICT_RATE*100)||'%' PREDICT_RATE_DESC, nvl(PSRB.SUBSCRIBE_AMOUNT,0) SUBSCRIBE_AMOUNT, nvl(PCD.CASH_PRINCIPAL,0) CASH_PRINCIPAL, nvl(PCD.CASH_INTEREST,0) CASH_INTEREST, nvl(CAPS.PUBLISH_AMOUNT,0)-nvl(PCD.CASH_INTEREST,0) SURPLUS_CASH_PRINCIPAL FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_STRUCTURE CAPS LEFT JOIN (SELECT CD.STRUCTURE_ID, SUM(PLAN_CASH_PRINCIPAL) CASH_PRINCIPAL, SUM(PLAN_CASH_INTEREST) CASH_INTEREST FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_CASH_DETAIL CD JOIN CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION CAPC ON CAPC.COLLECTION_ID=CD.COLLECTION_ID WHERE CAPC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' GROUP BY CD.STRUCTURE_ID) PCD ON PCD.STRUCTURE_ID=CAPS.STRUCTURE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PS.STRUCTURE_ID, SUM(PS.SUBSCRIBE_AMOUNT) SUBSCRIBE_AMOUNT FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_SUBSCRIBE PS WHERE PS.SUBSCRIBE_STATUS='CONFIRM' AND PS.SUBSCRIBE_TYPE='SELF_HOLDING_SUBSCRIPTION' GROUP BY PS.STRUCTURE_ID ) PSRB ON CAPS.STRUCTURE_ID=PSRB.STRUCTURE_ID WHERE CAPS.PRODUCT_ID=#{productId}
AND CAPS.SECURITY_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{securityNumber},'%'))
AND CAPS.PROJECT_GRADE LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{projectGrade},'%'))
ORDER BY CAPS.PROJECT_STRUCTURE

SELECT nvl(SUM(ROUND(((CAPS.PUBLISH_AMOUNT-nvl(PCD.CASH_PRINCIPAL,0)-nvl(PSRB.SUBSCRIBE_AMOUNT,0))* CAPS.PREDICT_RATE*#{interestPeriodDays}/ CAP.INTEREST_STANDARD_DAYS),2)),0) interest_sum FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_STRUCTURE CAPS JOIN CT_ABS_PRODUCT CAP ON CAPS.PRODUCT_ID=CAP.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CD.STRUCTURE_ID, SUM(PLAN_CASH_PRINCIPAL) CASH_PRINCIPAL, SUM(PLAN_CASH_INTEREST) CASH_INTEREST FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_CASH_DETAIL CD JOIN CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION CAPC ON CAPC.COLLECTION_ID=CD.COLLECTION_ID WHERE CAPC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' GROUP BY CD.STRUCTURE_ID) PCD ON PCD.STRUCTURE_ID=CAPS.STRUCTURE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PS.STRUCTURE_ID, SUM(PS.SUBSCRIBE_AMOUNT) SUBSCRIBE_AMOUNT FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_SUBSCRIBE PS WHERE PS.SUBSCRIBE_STATUS='CONFIRM' AND PS.SUBSCRIBE_TYPE='SELF_HOLDING_SUBSCRIPTION' GROUP BY PS.STRUCTURE_ID ) PSRB ON CAPS.STRUCTURE_ID=PSRB.STRUCTURE_ID WHERE CAPS.PRODUCT_ID=#{productId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_RECEIPT CAPR WHERE CAPR.STRUCTURE_ID=#{structureId}
